baseline_models.focus_anchor: The asking at word 1 governs the temporal construction at words 2-4.
baseline_models.mechanism: Question, temporal span, and reckoning combine into a demand to locate an appointed accounting event.

activation_trace.role: Question and request make the coming event the object of an explicit demand.
A span of time lets the day denote an appointed interval rather than daylight alone.
Accounting and recompense specify what becomes operative in that interval.

changed_reading.before: They request a calendar date for a named event.
changed_reading.after: They press to know when the appointed interval of accounting and recompense will become actual.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The temporal question modifies a day characterized by the financial branch of din.
baseline_models.mechanism: Financial liability turns the day into a maturity or settlement date, so the plural question sounds like pressure about when an outstanding obligation will be called in.

activation_trace.role: The request presses for disclosure of the obligation's timing.
A temporal term supplies the point at which settlement becomes due.
Debt and deferred exchange recast reckoning as an outstanding liability reaching maturity.

changed_reading.before: The day is only a remote eschatological label.
changed_reading.after: The day is also the due date on which deferred liabilities are settled.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The eventive branch of day combines with the coercive branch of din.
baseline_models.mechanism: A severe occurrence ends the askers' present autonomy by imposing dominion and compelled submission.

activation_trace.role: The speakers demand the timing of a condition they do not yet experience.
Day functions as the onset of a severe occurrence.
Subjugating dominion supplies the event's social force: resistance gives way to imposed rule.

changed_reading.before: They ask when an abstract judgment will happen.
changed_reading.after: They ask when the event that removes autonomy and imposes dominion will overtake them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The asking verb at word 1 has a non-dominant mapped branch of drawing something out gently and covertly.
baseline_models.mechanism: The interrogation becomes an attempt to pull a concealed timetable from its holder rather than a neutral request for information.

activation_trace.role: Gentle hidden extraction materializes the question as an effort to draw out withheld knowledge.
The hidden object being drawn out is a bounded temporal term.
Reckoning gives the concealed term consequential content.

changed_reading.after: The question tries to extract a concealed schedule of reckoning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening movement from dispersion through burden-bearing and flow to apportionment gives reckoning the shape of a process that gathers consequences and assigns shares.

activation_trace.role: Accounting anchors the process back in the focus as settlement rather than free-standing cosmic motion.
Wind-driven scattering supplies dispersed particulars that a final account must recover.
Bearing an entrusted burden turns what is carried into accountable responsibility.
Heavy load gives that responsibility measurable weight.
Flow carries the accumulated burden toward an endpoint.
Separating and assigning portions supplies the distributive act of settlement.

structural_cues: 51:1-4 forms an ordered participial sequence whose last operation is apportionment before 51:5-6 asserts fulfillment and din.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies scattering, accountable burden, movement, and apportioned shares; I infer a collection-to-settlement pipeline. A live alternative is that the sequence only depicts cosmic service without an accounting mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The reckoning day is a point on a calendar.
changed_reading.after: The reckoning day is the closure of a process in which dispersed deeds become carried burdens and apportioned outcomes.

context_deltas.mechanism: An appointed promise is affirmed through fulfillment and then described as falling and becoming fixed; the focus question therefore contests an already asserted actuality.

activation_trace.role: The temporal span remains the object whose arrival the speakers dispute.
An appointment bounded by time or place directly answers the temporal dimension of the focus.
Fulfillment moves the promise from speech toward accomplished fact.
The repeated reckoning root identifies the asserted event with the focus day.
Falling and becoming fixed gives the promised reckoning irreversible arrival.

structural_cues: The declarative certainty of 51:5-6 precedes the interrogative challenge of 51:12, with din repeated across them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies appointment, fulfillment, repeated reckoning, and fixed arrival; I infer that the later question is resistance to certainty rather than lack of notice. It could still be a sincere request for timing.

changed_reading.before: The speakers ask for missing chronological information.
changed_reading.after: The speakers challenge when an appointment already declared true and irreversibly arriving will land.

context_deltas.mechanism: A non-dominant mapped branch in the promise cue activates a counted waiting term, which joins the focus day and financial din as the expiry of a deferred liability.

activation_trace.role: The day supplies the duration whose remaining extent is questioned.
Deferred debt turns expiry of the term into maturity and settlement.
The split target's counted waiting period supplies a term running toward expiry.

structural_cues: 51:5 places the promise immediately before din at 51:6, while 51:12 later asks when its day is.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a counted-term branch under the promise root plus the focus debt branch; I infer that the term matures into settlement. The alternative is that this split mapping is only formal activation and does not govern the source sense.

changed_reading.before: The debt-day has an unspecified date.
changed_reading.after: A counted term is already running, and the question asks when deferred liability reaches maturity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ordered paths give way to conjectural speech taking divergent paths, being turned from its direction, and sinking into heedlessness; asking when becomes a rhetorical diversion from the claim's substance.

activation_trace.role: The explicit question is the focus act whose pragmatic function is being revised.
Interlaced, well-formed paths establish an ordered pattern against which discourse deviates.
Speech operating as conjecture makes the question part of speculation rather than settled inquiry.
Taking mutually different paths supplies the discourse's fragmentation.
Reversal away from a proper direction makes chronology a possible displacement from the issue.
An engulfing veil of falsehood and distraction supplies the question's cognitive environment.
Heedlessness explains why asking for timing can substitute for attending to accountability.

structural_cues: The missing-inventory root خ ر ص at 51:10 is used only as the structural label for conjecturing speakers between diversion and heedlessness.
The focus question immediately follows the description of immersion and inattention.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered paths, conjectural divergent speech, reversal, and heedlessness; I infer that the temporal question performs deflection. A live alternative is sincere confusion colored, but not caused, by its discourse setting.

changed_reading.before: When is a straightforward request for chronology.
changed_reading.after: When redirects debate into an unavailable timetable so the askers need not face the already asserted account.

context_deltas.mechanism: The requested day is identified by fiery assay and embodied tasting, while the later haste cue reveals the question as pressure to bring forward the very experience it doubts.

activation_trace.role: The request becomes the speech act retrospectively exposed as impatient pressure.
Recompense keeps the material ordeal anchored as execution of account.
The repeated day becomes the severe occurrence that answers the focus question.
Kindled fire supplies the assay's material medium.
Testing metal and persons reframes judgment as exposure of composition under stress.
Experiential tasting moves the answer from information to undergone knowledge.
Haste recodes the earlier timing question as a demand to advance the ordeal.

structural_cues: 51:13 begins with the same day noun immediately after the question, and 51:14 addresses the askers in the second person.
Question, answer, imperative experience, and recalled haste form a tight four-step sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies severe day, fire, assay, experience, and haste; I infer that the question participates performatively in hastening what it challenges. The alternative is that haste describes desire only, with no causal force.

changed_reading.before: The answer should be a date.
changed_reading.after: The answer is an assay they will know by undergoing it, and their question is itself impatient pressure toward that experience.

context_deltas.mechanism: Prior good action and repeated seeking of protective covering activate din as a practiced habit of obedience and self-accounting whose final day is culmination, not commencement.

activation_trace.role: Habit and customary condition let din operate before its climactic day.
Obedience gives the habit its governing orientation.
Precedence places formative action before the terminal account.
Active doing of good supplies the practiced content of obedience.
Seeking the covering of fault supplies repeated anticipatory self-accounting.

structural_cues: 51:15-18 contrasts the askers with people whose prior conduct and night practice already orient them toward account.
The missing-inventory root ه ج ع at 51:17 is used only as a structural cue within the little-at-night practice, not as branch evidence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prior good action and repeated seeking of protection from fault; I infer a habit that matures into the day of din. The alternative is a simple contrast of outcomes with no present-tense sense of din.

changed_reading.before: Din begins only when its future day arrives.
changed_reading.after: Its day consummates a regime already practiced as obedience, good action, and self-accounting.

context_deltas.mechanism: The asking root returns inside a relation of wealth, fixed entitlement, and deprivation, reversing the focus askers into people already answerable to present claims and activating din as social debt.

activation_trace.role: Financial liability anchors the social relation back in the focus day as settlement.
The focus speakers occupy the subject position of those who ask.
Accumulated property supplies the fund against which liability is asserted.
A fixed obligatory entitlement turns generosity into something due.
The same asking root returns as a claimant, reversing who asks and who must answer.
Deprivation identifies the unmet claim that makes settlement necessary.

structural_cues: 51:19 follows the portrait of prior good practice and repeats the focus asking root inside an economic relation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wealth, obligatory right, asker, and deprived party; I infer a role reversal linking future account to present unpaid claims. The alternative is a lexical echo that illustrates righteousness without selecting the financial din branch.

changed_reading.before: They ask when a remote account will begin.
changed_reading.after: Their question is ironic because present claimants already expose debts whose final settlement they demand to date.

context_deltas.mechanism: Visible signs, inward perception, an appointed promise, and truth compared with the askers' own speech shift the issue from absent chronology to unacknowledged present evidence.

activation_trace.role: The request for information is tested against evidence already available to its speakers.
A manifest sign supplies outward evidence that precedes disclosure of a date.
Stable knowledge without doubt names the epistemic outcome the evidence can support.
The self itself becomes a site of evidence rather than a detached questioner.
Inner discernment identifies the missing operation as perception, not data acquisition.
The appointed promise reconnects the evidence sequence to the focus demand for timing.
Truth matching reality establishes the claim's asserted epistemic status.
Analogy makes the speakers' own act a comparator for certainty.
Their undeniable speaking turns the source act of questioning into an ironic witness.

structural_cues: 51:20-23 moves from signs in the ground, to the self, to the promised, and finally to an oath comparing truth with the audience's own speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies signs, self-perception, appointment, truth, analogy, and speech; I infer that lack of a date is being used as if it were lack of evidence. The live alternative is that these signs establish occurrence but intentionally leave timing unanswered.

changed_reading.before: Certainty depends on receiving the requested date.
changed_reading.after: The date remains undisclosed, but their world, selves, and even their questioning speech already furnish evidence for the account.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus interrogative at word 2 has no packet root occurrence, while the activation comes from the context sign root. It remains anchored because that inventory explicitly contains both a manifest-sign branch and a temporal-interrogative branch matching the focus construction. Downstream prose should call this a packet-enabled lexical echo, not an asserted etymology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The uncatalogued temporal interrogative at focus word 2 is the live anchor.

activation_trace.role: The asking verb makes the uncatalogued interrogative an active component of the focus.
The sign branch supplies the visible-evidence pole of the echo.
The temporal-interrogative branch reaches back to the focus word and links when-language to the sign inventory.

changed_reading.before: When asks for a sign in the form of a date.
changed_reading.after: The very when-form is activated by the sign inventory, so the demand for a sign may itself be an unrecognized sign-bearing act.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it uses the non-dominant s-l-l mapping for the asking root. It remains anchored in the focus verb and gains context support when the same root recurs beside property and obligatory entitlement. Downstream prose should present the extraction as a material analogy, not replace ordinary asking with a homonymous sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus asking verb at word 1 is heard through its packet-supplied extraction branch.

activation_trace.role: Drawing something out gently and covertly casts the question as extraction of concealed time.
Accumulated property supplies a material whole from which a share can be drawn.
Obligatory entitlement makes the extracted portion due rather than stolen.
The recurring asking root lets the claimant draw a due share from property just as the focus speakers try to draw out a date.

changed_reading.before: Asking only transfers information from answerer to questioner.
changed_reading.after: Asking is imagined as drawing out what is withheld: first a concealed term, then a due share from accumulated property.

strongest_changes: 51:5-6 turns an open when-question into resistance to an appointment already affirmed as fulfilled and fixed in arrival.
51:13-14 replaces a requested date with embodied assay and exposes the question as hastening the experience it doubts.
51:19 reverses the askers into a present economy of wealth, claimant, obligatory right, and deprivation, activating din as debt and settlement.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sustains reckoning, debt maturity, imposed dominion, practiced obedience, and extractive questioning at once; context changes their mechanisms without forcing a single winner.
remaining_uncertainties: The askers' posture can remain sincere inquiry, skeptical challenge, or tactical deflection.
The financial and distributive readings may be structural analogies rather than selection of the debt sense in the focus.
The counted-term, temporal-sign, and extraction paths depend on explicit but non-dominant or cross-context packet branches and should remain exploratory.
